name: 轻流业务系统搭建
examples_zh: 帮我搭建一套采购管理系统，需要采购申请单、审批流程和数据看板
给已有的订单应用加上审批流程
examples_en: Build a procurement management system with request forms, approval workflow and dashboard
Add approval workflow to an existing order application
Add a data dashboard to the portal
description_zh: 构建、更新、修复、审核、发布和验证轻流业务系统。覆盖表单排版、视图、流程、门户、Word 打印模板及数据播种的端到端强制规范与最佳实践。
description_en: Build, update, repair, audit, publish, and validate Qingflow business systems. End-to-end conventions covering form layout, views, workflows, portals, Word print templates, and data seeding.
